theorems.name: Submission.bf_coneFree_countablyRectifiable
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ))), finrank ℝ W = n → ∀ (s r : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < r → ∀ E : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), (∀ a ∈ E, ∀ b ∈ E, dist b a < r → s * ‖b - a‖ ≤ ‖W.starProjection (b - a)‖) → CountablyRectifiable n E
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
